sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
SENIOR AI ENGINEER
AI/ML professional with nearly 4 years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions. Seeking a challenging role in a forward-thinking organization to leverage data-driven insights, drive innovation, and deliver scalable AI solutions that create measurable business impact.
PROFILE SUMMARY
Proficient in end-to-end ML lifecycle from data collection and experimentation to API integration and model deployment.  An effective communicator with proven skills in working with cross-cultural teams during the project phase; guiding & training team members and enabling knowledge sharing among the team.
Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into robust AI architectures and measurable outcomes.  Demonstrated thought leadership through open-source contributions, technical blogging, and participation in AI research and innovation.  Recognized for delivering high business impact through AI-driven efficiency improvements, automation solutions, and customer-facing innovations.

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
Projects & Research Open Source Contributions Multi-Agent Generator – Python Library | Creator & Maintainer  Developed a Python library that translates plain English instructions into fully configured multi-agent AI teams.  Implemented LLM-agnostic support using LiteLLM for compatibility with GPT, Claude, Llama, and other models.  Enabled 6+ agentic frameworks for flexible multi-agent architecture design.   Achieved 4,000+ downloads within six months and earned 100+ GitHub stars, reflecting strong community adoption.  Published on PyPI for easy installation and distribution.
Integrated automatic code generation and workflow visualization for streamlined development.
Enterprise AI Systems 2025 – Educational RAG Platform for CBSE Schools | AI Architecture Design & Implementation  Designed and deployed RAG system for an educational NGO, serving 1,000+ students across 4 schools.  Architected end-to-end RAG system optimized for CBSE curriculum content.  Developed intelligent retrieval mechanisms to provide students and teachers instant access to contextual learning materials.
Technical Content & Blogging  Published 80+ articles on Generative AI, LLMs, RAG systems, multi-agent frameworks, and enterprise AI solutions.  Covered GenAI fundamentals, LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, system design, AI governance, and cloud deployment.  Targeted content for AI practitioners, data scientists, and enterprise architects seeking practical AI implementation guidance.
Personal Projects
Autonomous AI Security Auditor Built an autonomous AI security auditor for AWS Bedrock, leveraging Bedrock Agents, Lambda orchestration, EventBridge-driven scheduled scans, and CloudTrail analysis to detect policy misconfigurations, insecure prompts, data-leak risks, and adversarial vulnerabilities across GenAI pipelines. Implemented S3-based audit logging, IAM configuration analysis, and DynamoDB-backed model– policy mapping to ensure enterprise-grade compliance, traceability, and safety.
IAM Framework for Agentic Systems (In Progress) Currently developing an IAM framework for LLM-based agent systems on AWS, adding agent identities, RBAC-style tool permissions, policy enforcement (PDP/PEP), and Bedrock Agent integration to enable secure, permission-scoped multi-agent orchestration
AI Evaluation System – IIT Bombay Mentorship Mentoring an IIT Bombay student to build a hierarchical AI-agent evaluation system where agents self-assess and escalate low-quality outputs. Designed a modular evaluation pipeline using CrewAI and FastAPI, improved reliability over traditional assessment methods.
